name: Orwell
description: The Gatstaf bell-ringer killed by Mrs. Palter.

timeline.summary: Elsa announces the bell-ringer Orwell is dead, and the trackers find the bodies of Orwell, Lady Evelin and Elder Somlon arranged in the woods.
timeline.quote: the same that had been done to the bell-ringer had been done to the ward-maker, Lady Evelin
